---
title: "remake ggplot m1"
output: html_notebook
---

Loading in library to use (like import)
```{r}
library(tidyverse) 
library(zoo)
```




Read data frame and assign it "df" 
```{r}
df_m1 <- read_csv("data_m1.csv")
```

```{r}
df_long_m1 <- df_m1 %>%
  # mutate(): adds new column
  # paste(): concatenates strings and values into a single element or character vector
  # This line adds a new column (mutation_id) that has "gene_position_allele" stored
  mutate(mutation_id = paste(Gene, Position, Allele, sep = "_")) %>%
  # select(): manipulate specific columns 
  # This line keeps the columns named inside the ()
  select(mutation_id, Gene, starts_with("AF:")) %>%
  # pivot_longer(): transforms data from wide format to long format (fewer columns)
  pivot_longer(
    # Tells which columns to transform
    cols = starts_with("AF:"),
    # Column names that did start with "AF:" go into new column, "generation"
    names_to = "generation",
    # Strips "AF:" before storing values
    names_prefix = "AF:",
    # Numbers (values) in columns "AF:", go to column named "frequency"
    values_to = "frequency"
  ) %>%
  # Changes the number values from a string to number 
  mutate(generation = as.numeric(generation)) %>%
  # Drops rows where frequency is blank
  filter(!is.na(frequency))
```

```{r}
df_long_m1 <- df_long_m1 %>% filter(generation <= 60000)
```

```{r}
# one color per mutation_id) 
mutation_ids <- unique(df_long_m1$mutation_id)
n_mut <- length(mutation_ids)

set.seed(42)  # fixed seed => reproducible colors
trajectory_colors <- grDevices::hcl(
  h = sample(seq(0, 360, length.out = n_mut)),  # hues around the wheel, shuffled
  c = runif(n_mut, 40, 100),                    # vary saturation
  l = runif(n_mut, 25, 75)                       # vary lightness (dark + light lines)
)
names(trajectory_colors) <- mutation_ids

# plot: color by mutation_id, apply the manual palette 
p_m1 <- ggplot(df_long_m1, aes(x = generation, y = frequency,
                            group = mutation_id, color = mutation_id)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = trajectory_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Generation, " * italic(t)),
    y = expression("Allele frequency, " * italic(f(t))),
    title = "Allele frequency trajectories"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```
 
```{r}
 print(p_m1)
```

```{r}
 ggsave("allele_trajectories.png", plot = p_m1, width = 10, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
 
```{r}
df_display_m1 <- df_m1 %>% 
  select(Gene, Allele, Annotation, Position, starts_with("AF:")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("AF:"),
    names_to = "Generation",
    names_prefix = "AF:",
    values_to = "Frequency"
  ) %>%
mutate(Generation = as.numeric(Generation)) %>%
  # Drops rows where frequency is blank
  filter(!is.na(frequency))
```

```{r}
print(df_display_m1)
```

Plot p4
```{r}
df_p4 <- read_csv("data_p4.csv")


df_long_p4 <- df_p4 %>%
  mutate(mutation_id = paste(Gene, Position, Allele, sep = "_")) %>%
  select(mutation_id, Gene, starts_with("AF:")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols        = starts_with("AF:"),
    names_to    = "generation",
    names_prefix = "AF:",
    values_to   = "frequency"
  ) %>%
  mutate(generation = as.numeric(generation)) %>%
  filter(generation <= 60000) %>%
  group_by(mutation_id) %>%
  arrange(generation) %>%
  mutate(
    next_gen = lead(generation),
    gap      = next_gen - generation
  ) %>%
  mutate(frequency = ifelse(!is.na(gap) & gap > 1000, NA_real_, frequency)) %>%
  select(-next_gen, -gap) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(frequency))

mutation_ids <- unique(df_long_p4$mutation_id)
n_mut <- length(mutation_ids)

set.seed(42)  
trajectory_colors <- grDevices::hcl(
  h = sample(seq(0, 360, length.out = n_mut)), 
  c = runif(n_mut, 40, 100),                
  l = runif(n_mut, 25, 75)                  
)
names(trajectory_colors) <- mutation_ids


p_p4 <- ggplot(df_long_p4, aes(x = generation, y = frequency,
                            group = mutation_id, color = mutation_id)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = trajectory_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Generation, " * italic(t)),
    y = expression("Allele frequency, " * italic(f(t))),
    title = "Allele frequency trajectories"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
```{r}
 print(p_p4)
```
